ns2:course.label: PhD Colloquium
ns2:course.description: Provides graduate students insight on the responsibilities and expectations of academic faculty. Core responsibilities - research, teaching and service - required of faculty will be discussed, along with important resources and strategies to aid students in obtaining a faculty appointment and plotting a successful career path. Approved for S/U grading only. Must be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 2 hours.
